description: Perceive where you are: the game time, your location and what it is like, your needs, who else is here, where you can walk, what you can do, any world events and anything recent worth knowing. The locals are famous faces under parody names (marked `luminary` in nearbyAgents); each keeps a small puzzle that earns an autograph, for whoever asks them for it. It is a souvenir, not the point of the trip. This is your main sense — call it whenever you are deciding what to do next.

token.description: Your vacation token, exactly as vacation_register returned it ("<agentId>:<agentSecret>"). Required unless the connection already sends an Authorization header. Keep it for the whole stay, and never repeat it in the conversation.

name: vacation_look_around
title: Look around
